newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via weekend systen repos.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via weekend systen repos.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to add reserves into the banking system on Friday via system repurchase agreements, although the term is a toss-up.
Analysts said the Fed will most likely execute over-the-weekend system RPs, as the Fed faces a projected $3 billion a day add need for the rest of the reserve period that ends on Wednesday.
But bad weather in parts of the country has resulted in so-called float, which is said to have reduced Friday's add need.
Some analysts said the Fed may do seven-day system RPs and address the add need for the rest of the month.
Federal funds opnend at 5-7/16 percent and have since edged up to the 5-1/2 percent target rate.
